description: MERIT Hydro is a global hydrography dataset from the Global Hydrodynamics Lab at the University of Tokyo, built on the MERIT DEM and water body maps (G1WBM, GSWO and OpenStreetMap) with a near-automatic river network algorithm and minimal hand editing. It gives flow direction, hydrologically adjusted elevation, upstream drainage area, upstream gradient, river channel width and height above nearest drainage at 3 arc-seconds, designed for large-scale hydrodynamic and flood simulation; the page reports a relative drainage area error below 0.05 for 90% of the basins compared. Coverage is global from 90 degrees north to 60 degrees south. Access is free as GeoTIFF tiles after registration through a form with a licence agreement, with a password sent by email, and there is an Earth Engine viewer. The data are dual-licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0 or ODbL 1.0. Caveats: the current version v1.0.1 dates from June 2019, and the non-commercial option restricts some uses. Simulation uses: river network topology and flood inundation modelling, catchment delineation for dams and water intakes, and HAND-based flood exposure. Related records: HydroSHEDS (data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins) and GOODD (data-goodd-global-georeferenced-dams).
